# VidSave - Free Online Video Downloader

> VidSave (https://videodownloader-37389.web.app) is a high-speed, 100% free web-based media extraction utility designed to download videos and audio from Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X, and over 1,000+ supported online video platforms in Full HD (1080p, 720p, 480p) and MP3 audio formats without requiring any software installation, registration, or subscription.

## Core Capabilities
- **Facebook Video Downloader:** Downloads Facebook Public Videos, Reels, Watch videos, and Stories in 1080p HD and SD MP4.
- **TikTok Video Downloader:** Fast video download without watermark in crystal clear quality.
- **Instagram Downloader:** Saves Instagram Reels, Posts, and Videos in original source quality.
- **YouTube Downloader:** High-speed direct MP4 video and MP3 audio extraction.
- **Multi-Platform Support:** Supports over 1,000+ video hosting platforms including Reddit, Twitter/X, Threads, and streaming sites.
- **Zero-Disk Streaming (Privacy & Speed):** Media is piped in real-time directly to the user's browser with zero local server storage, guaranteeing user anonymity and security.
- **Audio Extraction:** High quality MP3 audio-only extraction for music and podcasts.

## Key Features & Highlights
- **100% Free & Unlimited:** No hidden fees, no limits on number of downloads, and no registration required.
- **High Speed & Direct Download:** Fast processing with zero server queues or waiting delays.
- **Mobile & Desktop Responsive:** Fully optimized for iOS (iPhone/iPad), Android, Windows, Mac, and Linux browsers.
- **Safe & Anonymous:** No personal information or download history is stored or logged.

## How to Use
1. Copy the video link from Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or any supported website.
2. Paste the link into the VidSave input box at https://videodownloader-37389.web.app
3. Click "Get Video", choose the desired resolution (1080p HD, 720p, SD, or MP3 Audio), and download immediately.
